item.title: Today my little baby turns one. 🥹🐾🤍
item.description:
Today my little baby turns one. 🥹🐾🤍

He has only been in my life for a short time, but I already love him more than words could ever explain. We’ve travelled to so many beautiful places together — Paris, Rome, Milan, Sardinia, Monaco, Amsterdam… My little bun has been right by my side through everything.
Before him, I never knew it was possible to experience love and loyalty this pure and unconditional. There is truly nothing else like the love of a dog.
I may not have children of my own yet, but he is absolutely my baby, my family and one of the greatest loves of my life. I’m endlessly grateful to have him, and I know I’ll be by his side through every chapter of his whole life.

Happy first birthday to my Sheldon. I love him with all my heart. 🤍🎂🐩

item.title: India was everything I hoped it would be.
item.description:
India was everything I hoped it would be.

Before my trip, so many people warned me about the poverty, the chaos, and the difficult realities of life there. I knew I wouldn’t see every side of the country, but I already felt drawn to its culture, spirituality, nature, and people.

What I didn’t expect was to meet so many genuinely happy, kind, respectful, and warm-hearted people. Even while living through difficulties, they smiled so openly and carried such beautiful energy within them.

I fell even more in love with Indian food, its culture, nature, animals, and atmosphere. This journey will always have a special place in my heart — and I know I’ll return one day to discover more 🤍🇮🇳
